Multiclass.NotOnRow: {name} is not on the {race} row of the race and class table, so it cannot be this character's second class.

FreeCast.Spent: {name}: the free cast is spent until the next Short Rest.

Guise.Label: Guise
Guise.StepHint: You are a {race}. Choose the people whose form you wear: it gives your size, your Speed and your tongue, and nothing else.

SharedFeast.SameRest: Confirm this willing participant is still taking the same shared Short Rest. Do not approve an old unused portion for a later rest.
SharedFeast.CloseInstruction: Close or interrupt this meal session after reconciling pending participants. Paid food and claimed portions are not refunded or made available again.
SharedFeast.CreateInstruction: Select one carried Feast and up to six willing participants in the same Short Rest. This pays one Feast; each participant must independently choose their own rest.
SharedFeast.Refused: The shared Feast cannot be opened or needs GM reconciliation.
SharedFeast.Pending: A shared Feast rest is pending. The GM must reconcile or close its session before another rest.

HarmBelt.Ask: This attack has hit. Spend your Reaction and one Harm Prevention Belt use to gain temporary Health equal to twice your tier before its damage lands?
HarmBelt.Pending: Harm Prevention Belt needs GM review. The original hit remains unresolved; inspect its Reaction, use and temporary Health before continuing.
HarmBelt.Trigger: Harm Prevention Belt is offered when a confirmed attack hit is applied, before damage. Apply that original hit to answer it.
HarmBelt.ReviewHelp: Inspect this exact hit, Reaction, gadget use and temporary Health. Resolve any unfinished steps manually, then release this hold. This review neither repeats nor refunds them; the original hit has its separate Apply review.

HealerKit.Title: Kit-assisted Stabilize
HealerKit.ChooseTarget: Select one Dying character to stabilize.
HealerKit.ConfirmReach: GM: Confirm the helper can touch this patient. No scene distance is available.
HealerKit.ConfirmTarget: GM: Confirm this is the patient being stabilized. This spends a Half-Action and one kit use; no Medicine Test is made.
HealerKit.Refused: Kit-assisted stabilization was refused. Check the patient, reach, kit uses and action budget.
HealerKit.Pending: Kit-assisted stabilization needs GM review. Inspect its receipt before using the kit again.
HealerKit.Stabilized: One kit use and a Half-Action were spent. The patient is stabilized at 0 Health; no Medicine Test was required.
HealerKit.ReviewHelp: Inspect the Half-Action, kit charge and patient stabilization. Resolve unfinished steps manually, then release this hold. This review does not refund or repeat payment or stabilization.

PlacedDevice.AnchorInstruction: Enter the anchor elevation in scene distance units. The line is measured in three dimensions on the current level.
PlacedDevice.Declaration: The book does not specify an action cost. The GM declares the action required for this deployment.
PlacedDevice.Scene: Select one of this actor's tokens on the viewed scene.
PlacedDevice.Pending: This device operation needs GM review before another deployment.
PlacedDevice.Refused: The device operation is unavailable or its tracker has expired.
PlacedDevice.PlaceDummy: Choose the physical Target Dummy placement.
PlacedDevice.PlaceGrapple: Choose the grapple anchor within 60 feet.
PlacedDevice.Range: The grapple anchor must be within 60 feet.
PlacedDevice.ConfirmDummy: Confirm this is a physically reachable deployment location. Enemy bait and which attack is drawn remain GM decisions.
PlacedDevice.ConfirmGrapple: Confirm a legal anchor and unobstructed firing path. This records a placed line; it does not climb or change terrain.
PlacedDevice.RetrieveInstruction: Select the grapple the GM confirms has already been physically retrieved.
PlacedDevice.ReviewInstruction: Reconcile the physical device and action cost. Close this receipt without refunding or replaying. An uncertain dummy attack claim retires that tracker.

RocketBoots.Declaration: The GM declares the unstated action cost. One direct 1d20 malfunction roll is made without Skill Test modifiers or benefits. The activation moves exactly 60 feet straight even if the boots break on natural 1. One physical pair is spent; no rest or refuel reset is assumed.
RocketBoots.Pick: Choose a legal endpoint exactly 60 feet straight away
RocketBoots.Path: The endpoint must be exactly 60 feet away on a straight, same-level, unblocked path with room to land.
RocketBoots.Refused: Rocket boots need an unspent physical pair, active GM and one unambiguous scene token with a legal 60-foot path.
RocketBoots.Pending: Rocket boots activation is uncertain. Inspect the spent receipt, action, roll and token position before another operation.
RocketBoots.Malfunction: Rocket boots malfunction die (natural 1 breaks this pair)
RocketBoots.ReviewInstruction: Reconcile the recorded action, malfunction roll and actual movement. This closes the pending receipt; it does not refund the pair, reset its spent state, repair it or repeat movement.

AlarmBot.NeedsScene: Place Alarm-o-Bot on a scene, or adjudicate its watch at the table.
AlarmBot.Pick: Choose where the bot stands on the ground.
AlarmBot.ConfirmMinute: GM: confirm the user completed the uninterrupted minute and placed the bot on the ground at the chosen point. The watch lasts eight hours; this confirmation does not advance time.
AlarmBot.Deployed: Alarm-o-Bot is watching within 30 feet for eight hours.
AlarmBot.Refused: Alarm-o-Bot use refused: check the source, counter and placement.
AlarmBot.Uncertain: Alarm-o-Bot has an unresolved deployment or detection receipt. The GM must inspect it before retrying; no automatic payment or alarm replay.
AlarmBot.Detected: A creature triggered Alarm-o-Bot near grid location
AlarmBot.WakeNotice: The alarm wakes ordinary sleepers within 30 feet. Dream Theatre waking is resolved through its channel; magical Sleep is unchanged.
AlarmBot.OrdinaryWake: GM: confirm which ordinary sleepers are within 30 feet and now awake. Do not remove Unconscious or magical Sleep effects.
AlarmBot.AwakeDeclared: The GM confirms the nearby ordinary sleepers are awake.
AlarmBot.ConfirmPosition: GM: confirm the bot was placed on the ground at this new watch position. Movement costs are adjudicated at the table. Seed current occupants without a new arrival alarm; retain the original expiry.
AlarmBot.ReviewHelp: Inspect the paid use, watch, detected movement, Hide and Dream effects, and any existing alarm card. Close this hold only after resolving uncertainty. This neither refunds nor replays effects.
AlarmBot.AmbiguousHide: The Hide marker was cleared. Remaining independent or ambiguous invisibility carriers were preserved for GM review.

Parachute.ConfirmUnmeasured: GM: confirm the user is falling now. Select only allies falling with the user within 10 feet; distance and ally status are your judgement without scene geometry. Sideways movement is tracked at the table until a token is available.
Parachute.ReviewFeet: Actual sideways feet moved in this transaction (GM verified; enter 0 if cancelled)
Parachute.ConfirmFall: GM: confirm these creatures are falling together now. Only the user and allies within 10 feet on the same scene level receive the parachute.
Parachute.Refused: Parachute use refused: check the current fall, source use, reach, and action budget.
Parachute.Uncertain: Parachute transaction held for GM review. Do not repeat payment or movement; inspect the actor receipt and actual token positions.
Parachute.Pick: Choose a sideways destination within your remaining Speed for this falling round.
Parachute.ConfirmLand: GM: confirm this creature has landed. End its parachute protection and sideways allowance.
Parachute.ConfirmRound: GM: confirm a new round of this fall has begun outside combat. Refresh this creature's sideways allowance.
Parachute.ReviewHelp: Inspect the receipt, feature use, Reaction, actual movement and fall effects before closing the hold. No automatic refund, replay, or cure.

Prosthetic.Preview: Confirm {actor}: classify {injury} as the selected injury of {limb}. For a hand, the affected equipment hand is {hand}. This classification persists after detaching a prosthetic; remaining injury effects stay in place.
Prosthetic.MarkDamageInstruction: The GM determines this exact leg was damaged by the fall. No automatic fall threshold is assumed. Repair requires a successful Tinkering Test at the GM's chosen DC.
Prosthetic.Classify: Classify an existing limb or eye injury
Prosthetic.ClassifyInstruction: The GM confirms this existing effect represents a crippled/severed hand or leg, or a lost eye. Choose its exact limb. For a hand, explicitly map it to the weapon main hand or off hand. This applies only the printed injury restrictions; no injury is cured.
Prosthetic.PerceptionEye: Lost eye: Perception at distance only (table judgement)
Prosthetic.HandRefused: The selected weapon needs an injured hand that has no matching attached prosthetic.
Prosthetic.Instruction: Confirm the selected existing injury is a crippled or severed leg/hand, or a lost eye, matching this prosthetic and exact limb. Attach changes no armor slot and cures no injury. Mechanical leg cannot run; repair after a fall requires the GM's Tinkering DC. Detach restores the injury's restrictions.
Prosthetic.Refused: The prosthetic or injury changed, is unavailable, or does not match the chosen limb.
Prosthetic.FineWork: Fine work only (lockpick, pen, stopper): table judgement
Prosthetic.RangedEye: Lost eye: ranged Attack Bane remains

DeviceContext.Splint: Splint and sling: Critical Injury treatment; required Healer's kit available
DeviceContext.Disguise: Disguise kit: Deception to impersonate someone
DeviceContext.Ram: Athletics to force; two people swing together and both spend the action (confirm at the table)
DeviceContext.Magnifying: Investigation on small things only; both hands remain free
DeviceContext.Lockpick: Tinkering against a lock only; breaks on a natural 1
DeviceContext.Cables: Medicine to Stabilize only; cannot revive the dead; breaks on a natural 1
DeviceContext.RepairInstruction: Choose the broken device after the GM has adjudicated and completed its repair. This only records the completed repair; it supplies no free materials, time or Test.

Explosives.ReviewPlacementPrompt: Inspect the paid source, declared fuse, region, any blast card and actual recipient damage. Resolve unfinished steps manually before confirming. This retires the placement and removes remaining regions without damage, refund or replay.
Explosives.FuseSeconds: GM-declared fuse duration in seconds (no source duration is specified; enter 0 only for an explicitly immediate detonation)
Explosives.ConfirmCharge: GM: confirm this is a physically reachable placed charge, not a throw, in {scene}, level {level}, at ({x}, {y}) and elevation {elevation}. Its declared fuse lasts {seconds} seconds after placement. The charge stays here; actual creatures in its radius when it detonates are affected, including allies. Sapper's satchel spends the full turn to place.
Explosives.ConfirmSmoke: GM: confirm the smoke centre in {scene}, level {level}, at ({x}, {y}) and elevation {elevation}. The visible 20-foot radius blocks ordinary sight both ways for one minute on this level; nonvisual senses retain their own rules. No unstated throw range is assumed.
Explosives.GroundElevation: Ground elevation at the chosen square (scene units; GM confirmation required)
Explosives.ConfirmMine: GM: confirm this chosen ground square in {scene}, level {level}, at ({x}, {y}) and elevation {elevation}. No unstated range or fuse is assumed. An occupied square stays visibly unarmed until cleared and explicitly armed; an empty square arms immediately.
Explosives.MineOccupied: The mine square must be empty before it can be armed.
Explosives.ReviewMinePrompt: Inspect the mine region, original paid card, any blast card and every victim's actual Health. Resolve partial results manually before confirming. This retires the mine without damage, refund, or replay; any remaining region is removed.
Explosives.BurningWait: Thermite is still burning. Advance the actual world clock after the full turn has elapsed, then record completion.
Explosives.MetalTarget: Identify the exact metal lock, chain or bar
Explosives.ConfirmMetal: GM: confirm {target} is the exact metal lock, chain or bar to open. Thermite burns metal only and cannot be used as a weapon. It takes one turn to burn through; no map document is automatically deleted.
Explosives.PreparationRefused: The explosive preparation was cancelled or its source changed. No dose was spent.
Explosives.CompleteMetal: GM: confirm one full turn of burning has elapsed and {target} has opened. Record the fictional result; no Wall, Tile, actor or item is automatically destroyed.
Explosives.ReviewBurnPrompt: Inspect the target's Health and this burn receipt, then resolve any uncertain damage manually. Confirmation removes this held carrier without dealing damage or refunding the flask.
Explosives.UnstatedDuration: This source does not state a duration for Stunned. The GM must adjudicate its end. Confirm to apply the condition without an automatic expiry; remove it when the adjudicated duration ends.
Explosives.Pending: This explosive aftereffect is uncertain. The active GM must inspect the target and the card's equipmentExplosive receipt before another attempt; do not repeat the effect.
Explosives.ReviewPrompt: Inspect this target's effects and damage and resolve any partial application manually. This acknowledges the uncertain delivery without dealing damage, laying an effect, or refunding the item.

EquipmentRepair.Broken: This weapon is damaged by Unreliable and cannot be used until repaired.
EquipmentRepair.PendingBreak: Unreliable damage needs the active GM; this weapon remains unavailable. The active GM can review it from the actor directory's Equipment repair review menu.
EquipmentRepair.NoTarget: No carried weapon has Unreliable damage to repair.
EquipmentRepair.PendingRepair: Repair payment is uncertain; do not repeat it. The active GM must inspect the kit, weapon and receipt through the actor directory's Equipment repair review menu.
EquipmentRepair.Refused: The repair was refused; no repair was granted.
EquipmentRepair.Repaired: {name} repaired. One mechanical repair kit spent.
EquipmentRepair.ReviewPrompt: Inspect the kit quantity, weapon damage and displayed receipt first. Acknowledge this pending transaction without refunding, spending another kit or applying a repair. This only retires the pending receipt; adjudicate any correction separately.
EquipmentRepair.ManualPrompt: Confirm that this exact weapon has already been repaired by another means adjudicated by the GM. Clear only its Unreliable damage; no kit is spent or refunded. This does not acknowledge a pending kit payment.

Engulfment.IdentifyHelp: Identify this effect as only the lingering engulfment explicitly named by Shadow Flame. Its initial damage must be resolved separately. This classification grants no protection against other Fire, Shadow, breath or Scorched effects. Changed mechanics require identification again.
Engulfment.Prevented: Prevented by the equipped Onyxia Scale Cloak
Engulfment.NewHelp: Confirm that a new actual application of the identified lingering engulfment is occurring. This begins a separate application; it does not retry, cure or replace any previous carrier.
Engulfment.Uncertain: This engulfment application is uncertain. Inspect the source effect's header menu: Review engulfment application. Resolve partial targets manually before beginning another application. Do not retry uncertain writes.
Engulfment.ReviewHelp: Inspect each recorded target and its effects, and resolve any partial application manually. Confirmation closes the hold without curing or reapplying anything. A later application requires the separate Begin a new application action.

ProvisionBenefit.DrinkPending: This drink use is unavailable or requires GM review before another use.
ProvisionBenefit.DrinkReviewInstruction: Reconcile the paid action, physical portion and pending benefit. Close this receipt without refunding or replaying the drink. Retire any uncertain drink benefit through Review pending drink Tests.
ProvisionBenefit.DailyPending: This drink still supports normal rest recovery. Its extra once-a-day Boon remains manual until the day reset rule is defined.
ProvisionBenefit.ReviewInstructions: Inspect the pending drink Test receipts and any partial result. Confirm only after resolving the original Tests. This retires the held benefits without refunding or reapplying them. Pending paid-benefit grants are retired without refund or automatic reapplication; existing daily timestamps remain.
ProvisionBenefit.Awake: Spiced tea: this Test is to stay awake (table judgement)

SpecialEquipment.Refused: Equipment use was refused or could not be confirmed. Check remaining uses and any pending receipt before retrying.
SpecialEquipment.Target: Choose the willing creature to touch
SpecialEquipment.Touch: No unique scene measurement is available. Confirm at the table that these creatures are within touch reach.
SpecialEquipment.Minute: Confirm that one uninterrupted minute of eating has actually completed. This confirmation does not advance the clock or grant instant preparation.
SpecialEquipment.Consent: Confirm that {name} is willing to receive this item healing.
SpecialEquipment.Wolfshead: Spend the helm's once-per-Long-Rest use to begin this Shapeshift with 2 Ferocity?
SpecialEquipment.Pending: This equipment use has an uncertain result. Its payment remains recorded. The GM must inspect the receipt, resources and effects before allowing another use.
SpecialEquipment.ReviewInstructions: Inspect the recorded item, action, resources and effects. Correct any partial result manually. Confirm only when the original use has been resolved. This ends the hold without refunding or repeating that use.
SpecialEquipment.Chili: Use the prepared chili Reaction after this successful melee hit? All creatures in the 10-foot cone, including allies, make Reflex Resilience DC 16. Failure takes 2 Fire damage; success takes 1 before Ward.

Utility.Declare: Describe the spell's subject. The GM reviews eligibility before you spend Mana or an action.
Utility.Speaker: Present speaker and language
Utility.GMReview: Review the declared subject against the spell's limits. Findings remain private until a successful cast.
Utility.Eligible: The subject and stated prerequisites meet this spell's rules
Utility.Reach: Confirm range and presence for creatures without measurable tokens
Utility.Findings: What the caster learns (only facts this spell can establish)
Utility.Applied: The spell is in effect. Its stated limits and duration apply.

Utility.JunctionEligible: This junction is within 30 feet and within one mile of connected matching contaminated flow
Utility.Underwater: Confirm the speaker and selected recipients are underwater in ordinary water
Utility.Unavailable: This utility effect is no longer active or its recipients are out of reach.
Utility.Pending: This spell's new interaction is still being implemented. No action or Mana was spent.

Holy.Consent: Accept this prayer for your creature?
Holy.MendingReview: Confirm the selected creature is a willing ally within range before the cast is paid.
Holy.Ally: This creature is an ally and a valid prayer recipient
Holy.Reach: Confirm the distance where tokens cannot measure it
Holy.AfterFailed: The cast is recorded, but its effect needs review. Resolve the original cast; do not pay again.
Holy.Hostile: This event caused actual Health loss from hostile damage and left the holder above 0 Health
Holy.ChooseRecipient: Choose a different willing ally within 15 feet, or end the prayer if none is available.
Holy.NoRecipient: No legal recipient — end the prayer
Holy.JumpUnavailable: The prayer is not ready to jump, or this recipient is no longer eligible.

Holy.HealingNotLanded: Healing did not land; apply it now
Holy.NoDestroy: This spell does not explicitly destroy the target regardless of Health
Holy.DamageUnconfirmed: Damage was applied, but the Holy spell consequence could not be confirmed. Ask the GM to review the spell receipt before continuing.
Holy.VerdictRecoveryCheck: Review the original cast and the target's committed Health loss. Protection needs a valid spent Verdict receipt. If there is no protection, handle the held injuries manually before clearing this hold.
Holy.VerdictInjuriesHandled: No protection; injuries handled by the GM

ThematicShadow.Visible: The sound point is visible to the target
ThematicShadow.Range: Confirm the target is within 60 feet of the caster and the sound point is within 30 feet of the target

ThematicShadow.ChannelReview: Confirm this mental connection's entry conditions from the spell.
ThematicShadow.Willing: All selected Mindlink members are willing
ThematicShadow.Met: The caster has met this target
ThematicShadow.NoArcaneAnchor: Arcane Anchor does not prevent this Sending
ThematicShadow.BoundaryReview: Review Mindstatic boundary for this delivery

ThematicShadow.MindlinkConsent: Join this voluntary Mindlink? You may leave at any time.
ThematicShadow.SendingConsent: Accept this Sending? You may refuse it.
ThematicShadow.SendingWindowReview: Outside combat, Sending's reply window stays open only until the world clock next advances. Confirm the sender's current turn is still open.

ThematicShadow.PrivateChannel: Only the selected channel members and the GM receive this message.
ThematicShadow.HalfAction: The sharing member spends a Half-Action
ThematicShadow.UnverifiedReport: GM-described borrowed perception; not automatic vision or external truth

ThematicShadow.Unavailable: This Shadow or mental-channel action is unavailable. Ask the GM to review its receipt.

RocketJump.Refused: Rocket Jump could not complete. If payment began, the GM must inspect the feature's Rocket Jump receipt before another attempt.

HungerMastered.Title: The Hunger Mastered
HungerMastered.ReviewNone: No supported interrupted uses need review.

Zalazane.Title: Zalazane's Lesson

DominationOrder.DeliveryPending: Domination delivery was not confirmed. The active GM must inspect the target and delivery record before retrying; do not repeat the cast automatically.
DominationOrder.Title: Order-triggered save
DominationOrder.ClockExplain: Resolve any past minute saves at the table, then enter how many seconds remain until the next save. Zero means a save is due now. This does not roll a Test or change the domination.
DominationOrder.ClockAck: I have reconciled all past minute saves.
DominationOrder.ClockDone: Enslave Demon's next minute save is scheduled. No Test was rolled.
DominationOrder.MissingClock: Enslave Demon on {name} has no verified minute deadline. The GM must reconcile the elapsed time and past saves; automatic minute saves are unavailable for this legacy effect.
DominationOrder.Minute: One minute of Enslave Demon has elapsed. Resolve this minute's Spirit Test. Cancelling leaves it due; multiple elapsed minutes are resolved separately.
DominationOrder.Harmful: Confirm a new Dominate order to harm this creature or one of its allies. It immediately repeats its Spirit Test with a Boon.
DominationOrder.Destruction: Confirm a new Enslave Demon order to destroy itself. It immediately repeats its Spirit Test.
DominationOrder.MissingDC: The original casting DC cannot be verified. The GM must adjudicate this save.
DominationOrder.Pending: This order's save is unresolved. Reconcile the recorded attempt, result and effects through Review interrupted uses in the Actors directory before making another Test.

MilitiaDrill.Title: Militia Drill
MilitiaDrill.Target: Target the actor who will make the drilled group's single Test.

HealingReview.Title: Review interrupted signature healing
HealingReview.Help: Check the recipients' Health and reconcile the interrupted healing manually before continuing. Missing cards do not prove that no healing occurred. Review closes the original bonus allowances as spent and prevents the uncertain healing from repeating. A pending periodic pulse advances its countdown once; later pulses may continue. This does not restore or remove Health.
HealingReview.Acknowledge: I reconciled the recipients' Health and accept closing these attempts without replay.
HealingReview.Done: Healing attempts reviewed without repeating healing.
HealingReview.Failed: Review could not finish. Reopen it after checking changes to recipients, cards, effects, or the previous GM's connection.

DamageReview.SealingHelp: Sealing Flame casting was interrupted for this recipient. Reconcile the original hit, casting costs, Health, Bleeding and injury stabilization manually, then record whether the recipient benefited. This does not replay or refund anything.
DamageReview.SealingResult: Did this recipient benefit from Sealing Flame?
DamageReview.Title: Review interrupted signature damage
DamageReview.Help: Reconcile the recipients' damage and any transferred shares before continuing. This closes all remaining signature bonuses for the listed castings, marks pending area hits reviewed, and advances each pending timed pulse once. A missing spell card is replaced by a recovery record with no signature bonus. For recovered areas, reconcile the current combat turn manually; automatic base damage resumes on later turns. This does not change Health or replay damage. Attack and transfer recovery remain separate.
DamageReview.RecoveryRecord: The GM reconciled a spell whose original card was missing. This record preserves its remaining base damage; its signature bonuses are closed. Recovered areas resume automatic damage after the manually reconciled combat turn.
DamageReview.Acknowledge: I reconciled these hits, any Sealing Flame condition removal and injury stabilization, and accept closing the casting without replay.
DamageReview.Done: Signature damage reviewed without repeating damage.
DamageReview.Failed: Review could not finish. Check the recipients, cards, and previous GM's connection before reopening it.

HitReview.Title: Review signature attack
HitReview.Help: An attack was interrupted while recording its signature bonus. Check any surviving attack cards and settle their damage and action costs manually before continuing. A missing card does not prove that nothing happened. This review marks the listed allowances spent on their original turn; it does not roll, apply damage, or refund resources.
HitReview.Acknowledge: I have reconciled these attacks and accept closing their signature allowances as spent.
HitReview.Done: Signature attack allowances reviewed. No attack or damage was repeated.
HitReview.Failed: Review could not finish. Check that the previous writer disconnected and that the actor and cards have not changed.

ParryReview.Title: Review interrupted Conqueror Parry
ParryReview.Help: Check the Parry Test, incoming attack, reaction, Momentum payment and resulting effects. Reconcile any uncertain changes before continuing. This closes the bonus claim as spent for its original turn; ordinary turn refresh still applies. It does not roll, refund, charge, negate damage or change any attack card. A connected previous GM writer must finish or disconnect first.
ParryReview.Acknowledge: I reconciled this Parry and its costs and effects. Do not repeat the attempt.
ParryReview.Done: The Parry bonus claim was reviewed. No roll, resource or attack result was changed.
ParryReview.Failed: Review was not confirmed. State changed, the operation is running, or its previous GM writer is still connected.

KillReview.Title: Review interrupted kill rewards
KillReview.Help: Check the original kill, Health restored and temporary Health granted. Reconcile uncertain changes manually first. Recorded actor allowances close as spent on their original turn; card-only claims do not create an allowance. This does not grant, refund or repeat either reward. Original attack cards remain non-replayable, including when a card or target has been deleted.
KillReview.Acknowledge: I have reviewed and reconciled these rewards. Do not repeat them.
KillReview.Done: The pending kill allowances were reviewed. Health and temporary Health were unchanged.
KillReview.Failed: Review was not confirmed. State changed, delivery is running, or a previous GM writer is still connected.
